categories.name: build
categories.evidence: Modifies depends/packages/sqlite.mk to set -DSQLITE_SECURE_DELETE in depends builds.
categories.rationale: Enabling a compile-time option in the SQLite depends package is a minor configuration adjustment to match typical Linux distribution defaults. It has minimal impact on build system maintenance or release integrity.

categories.name: wallet
categories.evidence: Changes SQLite database initialization and PRAGMA settings in src/wallet/sqlite.cpp, removes VACUUM rewrite handling, and adds wallet encryption tests.
categories.rationale: Zeroing deleted and updated records prevents sensitive master encryption keys and private keys from lingering in database free pages across passphrase changes. As noted in the description, changing the passphrase previously left superseded encryption key records intact in unallocated pages.
